purpose: CPU-only development screening of a supervised immediate-answer correctness readout, using already acquired causal prefix labels and existing hidden states.
hypothesis_origin: A new hypothesis after the fixed three-consistent-answers policy failed its safety gate. Repeated answers alone can remain wrong. This readout is a separate supervised decision mechanism; the failed policy is not relabeled or retuned.

evidence.use: Prefix-only features paired with actual forced-answer outcomes support supervised stop decisions; their risk tolerance and costs do not transfer automatically.
Correctness decoding at a completed reasoning boundary does not establish safe prefix stopping. Here labels are the actual saved-prefix trial outcomes.

feature_join: For prefix length k ending in a generated delimiter, use the existing predecessor state at absolute position prompt_length+k-1, matched by the following complete step start=k. Exclude unavailable rows without replacement; require >=95%coverage. Never use the following step's confidence or tokens.

split.rule: Random24 of the existing32 question IDs for fit; remaining8 for CPU checks. All steps from one question stay together. No feature, threshold or model choice on the holdout.

models.candidate: Question-weighted standardized ridge regression on1536 predecessor-state features, divided by sqrt(feature dimension), ridge alpha1. Center/scale and output intercept use training data only; no layer or regularization search.
controls: The same weighted ridge using prefix length only
The same weighted ridge using the preceding completed step's arithmetic confidence and two-step variance only
models.weight: Each training question has equal total weight; rescale sample weights to mean1.
models.threshold: Strictly above the maximum fitted training score among incorrect trial answers. Never choose a threshold from holdout labels. Regression scores are not calibrated probabilities.

cost: Existing local memmaps plus a matrix solve on at most327 rows. No GPU, new answers, hidden replay or model load.
decision: A failed gate stops this readout without fitting other layers, thresholds or regularization values. A pass permits only preparing a stronger independent validation and actual online implementation, not a compression claim.
limitations: Only32 length-selected calibration questions,23 originally capped; the original layer was selected using calibration data. This is development evidence, not independent efficacy confirmation.
Hidden features came from the existing teacher-forced replay, whereas trial answers used vLLM. Numerical transfer to an online observer is not yet verified.
Correctness of a forced short answer is the label; future full-trajectory correctness and answer convergence are not input features.
Zero false acceptances on a small holdout cannot establish a narrow population safety guarantee.
